card.line: Damascus is an ancient, important city of Syria, north of Jerusalem, where Elisha spoke to Hazael, Assyria conquered it, and Saul met Jesus and began to preach.

moments.title: Elisha and Hazael
moments.text: Elisha came to Damascus while King Ben-hadad was sick. Hazael brought a gift and asked if the king would recover. Elisha said the LORD had shown him that Hazael would be king over Aram.

moments.title: Assyria captures Damascus
moments.text: King Ahaz of Judah asked Assyria for help. The king of Assyria marched up to Damascus and captured it, took its people to Kir, and put Rezin to death.

moments.title: Ahaz copies an altar
moments.text: Ahaz went to Damascus to meet the king of Assyria. He saw an altar there and sent plans for it to Uriah the priest, who built one in Jerusalem. Ahaz then made offerings on it.

moments.title: Saul meets Jesus
moments.text: Saul was heading to Damascus to arrest followers of the Way. A light from heaven flashed around him, and Jesus spoke to him. Saul was left blind and was led by the hand into Damascus.

moments.title: Ananias helps Saul
moments.text: The Lord sent a disciple named Ananias to Saul. Ananias placed his hands on him, and Saul could see again. Saul was baptized and spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.

moments.title: Saul preaches Jesus
moments.text: Saul began to proclaim in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God. He grew stronger and confounded the Jews in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
